protocol.data_access: CIFAR-100 train split only; probe rows excluded from LT training pool
protocol.eri: R / (W + D + epsilon), where D is class-absent positive refresh
protocol.primary_unit: per tail class, per audited trajectory round

control_config.feedback: training-side functional feedback: unscaled cosine margin, fixed views, all training samples
control_config.offline_probe: offline mechanism probe; never used for decisions
control_config.rng_protocol: v2: functional and official evaluations are observational; legacy CE results are historical only
control_config.privacy: simulated class sum/count uploads; class presence visible; no secure aggregation or DP
control_config.checkpoint_encoding: full base state plus exact changed tensors
